exposure: mode of delivery (vaginal delivery vs. cesarean section)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 149 primiparous women at 42 days postpartum who underwent pelvic floor ultrasound.
finding: The study developed a nomogram model combining ultrasound and serum FGF2/HBP, which accurately predicts the risk of postpartum pelvic floor dysfunction.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was identified as an independent risk factor for postpartum pelvic floor dysfunction, showing higher incidence and more frequent abnormal pelvic floor ultrasound findings compared to cesarean section.
birth_weight: Neonatal birth weight >= 4 kg was identified as a risk factor.
